sources.observation: Castle allocates exactly twenty player-map acquisition flags.
Opcode 29 writes the absolute authored ID without checking it against the twenty-byte array.
The Maps/Notes menu reads record slots zero through nineteen while iterating visible menu entries one through twenty.
Only twenty acquisition bytes are persisted.
Only those twenty acquisition bytes are restored.
The player-map renderer divides by the authored iconSize without first proving it is positive.

castleSourceObservation.recordIdentity: IDs zero through nineteen address the twenty saved player-map records; ID twenty writes beyond Castle's acquisition table.
castleSourceObservation.iconSize: A zero iconSize reaches integer division in both crop sizing and current-party marker bounds.
castleSourceObservation.result: Both malformed authored values enter undefined native behavior rather than a stable player-visible rule.

realmz2ChosenResult.recordIdentity: Providence and the independent runtime loader reject Classic player-map IDs outside zero through nineteen.
realmz2ChosenResult.iconSize: Providence and the independent runtime loader reject iconSize values less than one before content construction or presentation.
realmz2ChosenResult.state: No rejected record can create acquisition state, a VM continuation, or a save entry.
realmz2ChosenResult.compatibility: No legacy quirk is provided unless an authored scenario and controlled Castle fixture establish a player-visible dependency on either unsafe value.
